text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali says on May Day that Tunisia must count on itself for development through quality work and efficiency.
- Trade unions hold May Day rally in village of Soliman, 30 km (20 miles) south of Tunis.
- Tourists from Russia total 34,000 in 1996, up from only 600 a year before 1990.
- Prime Minister Karoui to chair seminar on May 13 to look at how to promote and finance exports.
- New legislation eases bidding procedures for public firms.
- President says Tunisia must succeed in modernising economy; awards medals to trade unionists; trade unions express support for government's development strategy.
- Subscribers allowed to pay telephone bills through banks.
